title: Stream
description: Live streaming session with streamer, title, viewer count, status, and start time. Used for live streaming platforms, gaming streams, and video broadcasting services.

title.description: Title or name of the stream

streamer.description: Full name or username of the person streaming

url.description: URL to watch or access the live stream

viewers.description: Current number of viewers watching the stream

status.description: Stream status (e.g., live, offline, scheduled, ended)
